none: PAS FindID 944019: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Trier mint Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17; over one third of flan lost. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other holding wreaths aloft; an object like a small fir between them. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 16.5mm, Weight: 0.88gms, die axis: 6
